description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It sets up test data and verifies various data retrieval methods related to performance tracker logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing PerformanceTrackerLogDao methods related to performance tracker logs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by setting up the PerformanceTrackerLogDao instance and test data fixture.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a performance tracker log by ID, verifying related tracker and employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Tests fetching logs by tracker ID under different scenarios, checking counts.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Tests counting positive and negative achievement logs for a given tracker.
